88595.title: Dashboard link shows for anyone with the Reports permission
88595.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. Two custom roles made from the same template (e.g. Service Advisor): ZZAUTOTEST With Reports (Reports switched on) and ZZAUTOTEST No Reports (Reports switched off).
  4. Two staff members at that location whose sign-ins you have: ZZAUTOTEST Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST With Reports, and ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports.
  5. You have copied the dashboard's web address.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
  • For 3: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Choose a template: Service Advisor > Apply > Role Name ZZAUTOTEST With Reports > under Page Access switch Reports on > Create. Then the second role the same way: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Choose a template: Service Advisor > Apply > Role Name ZZAUTOTEST No Reports > under Page Access switch Reports off > Create.
  • For 4: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (ZZAUTOTEST Reports User), an Email you can open, Role ZZAUTOTEST With Reports, a Department, Location = your location > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, so you can sign in as them; then the same for ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports.
  • For 5: while signed in as Admin, click Dashboard in the top menu and copy the address from the browser bar.
88595.custom_steps:
1. In a private browser window, sign in as ZZAUTOTEST Reports User.
  2. Look at the top navigation bar.
  3. Sign out (profile icon > Logout), then sign in as ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User.
  4. Note which screen you land on after signing in.
  5. Look at the top navigation bar.
  6. Paste the dashboard address you copied into the browser bar and press Enter.
88595.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • As ZZAUTOTEST Reports User (Reports permission on, no other setting changed), the top bar shows "Dashboard" to the right of "Reports". No other switch, feature setting or dashboard permission had to be turned on.
  • As ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User, you land on Work Orders after signing in.
  • As ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User, the top bar shows neither "Reports" nor "Dashboard".
  • Typing the dashboard address takes ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User to Work Orders. No error page appears and no dashboard figures appear at any moment.
  • The server also refusing the dashboard's data to that user is a developer or automated check: this part cannot be checked by hand; write 'not checked by hand' in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9573 (Story 1, Dashboard Access and Entry Point); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 1. Design canvas board 01_Opens_After (row 1) for the top bar labels.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R6: “The "Dashboard" entry is shown to any user who has the reportsPageAccess permission, the same permission that shows the "Reports" entry. That permission is the only gate: there is no organization-level Dashboard feature and no other switch.”
  • S1-R8: “A user who lacks the permission in S1-R6 lands on Work Orders. This applies both to where they land after logging in and to entering the dashboard address directly, which redirects to Work Orders rather than showing an error page.”
  • S1-R7: “The gate in S1-R6 is enforced by the server, not only by hiding the navigation entry. A request to any of the dashboard's own endpoints from a user who lacks reportsPageAccess is refused with an authorization failure and returns no dashboard data. Hiding the entry is a convenience for the user, never the control.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.

88596.title: Without the Reports permission there is no Dashboard link
88596.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. For the setup you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission).
  2. A staff member whose role has the Reports permission switched off, with access to one location, whose sign-in you have (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User with role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports).
  3. You have copied the dashboard's web address.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Choose a template: Service Advisor > Apply > Role Name ZZAUTOTEST No Reports > under Page Access switch Reports off > Create; then profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User), an Email you can open, Role ZZAUTOTEST No Reports, a Department, Location = your location > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, so you can sign in as them.
  • For 3: while signed in as Admin, click Dashboard in the top menu and copy the address from the browser bar.
88596.custom_steps:
1. Open a private browser window and sign in as ZZAUTOTEST No Reports User.
  2. Note the screen you land on.
  3. Look along the whole top navigation bar for a "Dashboard" entry.
  4. Paste the dashboard address into the browser bar and press Enter.
88596.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After signing in, the user does not land on the dashboard (they land on Work Orders).
  • The top navigation shows no "Dashboard" entry.
  • The dashboard cannot be opened: the address leads back to Work Orders and no dashboard tiles are shown.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9573 (Story 1, Dashboard Access and Entry Point); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N2: “If the user does not have the Reports permission, they do not land on the dashboard when they log in.”
  • S1-N1: “If the user does not have the Reports permission, the "Dashboard" entry is not shown and the user cannot open the dashboard.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.

88597.title: The shop logo in the top bar does nothing when clicked
88597.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You are in any location (workplace).
  3. You have a small screen ready: a phone, or a tablet held upright, or a desktop window made narrower than 1024 pixels (the dashboard tiles stack into one column when it is narrow enough).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
88597.custom_steps:
1. On a desktop-width window, click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. Hover the mouse over the shop logo at the far left of the top bar.
  3. Click the shop logo.
  4. Open the site on the small screen.
  5. Tap the shop logo.
  6. Tap the menu button beside the logo (the icon with three lines).
88597.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On desktop, the logo does not behave as a link: the pointer does not change to a hand and no link address appears at the bottom of the browser.
  • Clicking the logo does nothing: the screen and the browser address stay the same.
  • On the small screen, tapping the logo does nothing and does not open the menu.
  • On the small screen, the menu button is separate from the logo, shows its own menu icon, and opens the menu when tapped.
  • That clicking the logo sends no analytics event is a developer or automated check: this part cannot be checked by hand; write 'not checked by hand' in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9573 (Story 1, Dashboard Access and Entry Point); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 1. Design canvas board 14_Phone_After (row 14) for the small-screen top bar.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N5: “The shop logo in the top navigation is not a link, at any screen size.”
  • S1-N6: “Selecting the shop logo does nothing, at any screen size.”
  • S1-N7: “On a small screen the shop logo is not part of the menu button, so tapping the logo does not open the menu.”
  • S1-N8: “On a small screen the menu button has its own menu icon and opens the menu when tapped.”
  • S1-N9: “Selecting the shop logo sends no analytics event.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.

88598.title: Switching workplace reloads the dashboard figures
88598.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You open the site in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so nothing remembered from an earlier visit is in play.
  3. Two locations (workplaces) whose figures differ: your normal location (e.g. Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and one with nothing in it (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: both are in the Change Location list (click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list). If no empty location exists, create one: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop), Address 1, City, State/Province, ZIP/Postal Code, Timezone, Telephone > Save & Close; it appears in the Change Location list at once. Create nothing in it.
88598.custom_steps:
1. Change location to your normal location (profile icon > Change Location) and click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. Write down the six tile headlines (e.g. Revenue $2,422.00).
  3. Without leaving the dashboard, change location to ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop (profile icon > Change Location).
  4. Read the six tile headlines again.
  5. Change location back to your normal location.
  6. Look for any way to have no location selected (for example in the Change Location list).
88598.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After you pick the other workplace, the dashboard reloads by itself and the headlines change to that workplace's figures (for the empty workplace: Revenue $0.00, Sales by Customer 0 customers, At Risk Customers 0). No figure from the first workplace stays on screen.
  • Picking the first workplace again brings back the figures you wrote down.
  • With no workplace selected, the dashboard loads no figures. If the build gives you no way to have no workplace selected, write 'no-workplace state not reachable by hand' in the result comment and pass or fail on the first two results.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9573 (Story 1, Dashboard Access and Entry Point); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-E1: “If the user switches the selected workplace in the top navigation, the dashboard reloads its figures for the newly selected workplace.”
  • S1-E2: “If no workplace is selected, the dashboard does not load data.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.

88599.title: The six tiles always show in the same order for every user
88599.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. A second staff member whose role is different but also has the Reports permission (e.g. a Service Manager), whose sign-in you have.
  4. You are in any location (workplace).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: check the role has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on Service Manager > Reports is switched on. If you have no such staff member: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (ZZAUTOTEST Second Viewer), an Email you can open, Role Service Manager, a Department, Location = your location > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, so you can sign in as them.
  • For 4: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
88599.custom_steps:
1. Click "Dashboard" in the top navigation.
  2. Read the tile names in the top row from left to right.
  3. Read the tile names in the second row from left to right.
  4. Open a private browser window and sign in as the second user.
  5. Click "Dashboard" and read both rows again.
88599.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Top row, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.
  • Second row, left to right: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.
  • The second user sees exactly the same six tiles in exactly the same places.
  • Both users see all six tiles (none is missing for either user).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9574 (Story 2, One Fixed Layout); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 2. Design canvas board 01_Opens_After (row 1).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “The dashboard shows the four KPI tiles in a fixed top row, left to right: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization.”
  • S2-R2: “The dashboard shows the two count tiles below the KPI row, left to right: Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.”
  • S2-R3: “The tile set and their order are the same for every user.”
  • S2-R4: “Every user who can open the dashboard sees all six tiles.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.

88600.title: The dashboard has no way to add, remove, move or hide tiles
88600.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in any location (workplace).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
88600.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. Look over the whole page, each tile's header and corners, and the top of the page for any button, menu, pencil, gear, plus sign, close cross or eye icon.
  3. Right-click a tile and look at the menu that opens.
  4. Try to drag a tile by its title to another position.
  5. Sign out (profile icon > Logout), sign in again and click Dashboard in the top menu.
  6. Open the dashboard in a different browser or a private window.
88600.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • There is no control to add a tile.
  • There is no control to remove a tile (no close cross or remove option).
  • There is no control to reorder tiles, and dragging a tile does not move it.
  • There is no control to hide or show tiles.
  • After signing in again, and in the other browser, the layout is the same fixed six tiles in the same order: no saved layout carries over.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9574 (Story 2, One Fixed Layout); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 2.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-N1: “The user has no control to add a tile.”
  • S2-N2: “The user has no control to remove a tile.”
  • S2-N3: “The user has no control to reorder tiles.”
  • S2-N4: “The user has no control to hide or show tiles.”
  • S2-N5: “No saved layout carries over between sessions.”

88618.title: Each tile opens on its default date range on every visit
88618.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list.
88618.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Read the text in the date pill of each tile.
  3. Change the Revenue pill to Last Year (click Apply if the calendar stays open).
  4. Change the Sales by Customer pill to This Week.
  5. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  6. Click Dashboard in the top bar again.
  7. Read the text in the date pill of each tile.
  8. Sign out, sign back in and click Dashboard.
  9. Read the text in the date pill of each tile.
88618.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On the first visit the Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization pills read This Month, and the Sales by Customer pill reads Last 12 Months. Each pill is blue with a calendar icon.
  • After leaving and coming back, Revenue reads This Month again (not Last Year) and Sales by Customer reads Last 12 Months again (not This Week).
  • After signing out and back in the pills again show the same defaults.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9579 (Story 7, Per-Tile Date Ranges); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 7. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 01_Opens_After and 03_Range_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R7: “The four KPI tiles open on This Month. The Sales by Customer tile opens on Last 12 Months.”
  • S7-R7: “The four KPI tiles open on This Month. The Sales by Customer tile opens on Last 12 Months.”
  • S7-R8: “A tile's date range is not carried between visits. Every visit opens each tile on its default from S7-R7, which is why date ranges are absent from the remembered list in S6-R16. This is a deliberate change from the earlier dashboard, which remembered them.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
